01AI-assisted no-code app builder

Apptura

AI-assisted no-code mobile app builder that generates fully editable mobile applications from natural-language prompts through a visual editor.

  • Achieved consistent rendering across React/TypeScript web and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose Android by building a shared schema for reusable blocks, layouts, actions, and data bindings.
  • Designed an AI page-generation pipeline using OpenAI structured outputs, a versioned schema, deterministic compilation, automatic layout and collision repair, and compiler-guided retries.
  • Developed a Node.js, Express, and MongoDB backend with more than 30 authenticated and public API routes, deployed across Azure App Service, Static Web Apps, and Blob Storage using GitHub Actions CI/CD.
